lines.speaker: NOVA
lines.text: A child has been asking every soldier in Haven-01 for the person who lifted the bus.

lines.speaker: PLAYER
lines.text: Daniel.

lines.speaker: DANIEL
lines.text: You came! I drew you. That's you, and that's the bus, and that's the monster. The monster's smaller than it was because you won.

lines.speaker: PLAYER
lines.text: It's a good drawing. How's your dad?

lines.speaker: DANIEL
lines.text: His leg's bad. The medic said he needs pills they don't have. They said the old pharmacy in the Eastern blocks might have some. But it's got things in it now.

lines.speaker: PLAYER
lines.text: Then I'll go and get them.

lines.speaker: DANIEL
lines.text: Promise?

lines.speaker: PLAYER
lines.text: Promise.

lines.speaker: NOVA
lines.text: You use that word very easily, for someone it is a title for.

lines.speaker: NOVA
lines.text: Fracture growths on the shelves. And things living in them.

lines.speaker: NOVA
lines.text: Medicine located. Antibiotics, painkillers. Enough for his leg and three other patients.

lines.speaker: PLAYER
lines.text: Take all of it.

lines.speaker: NOVA
lines.text: There is a box of children's vitamins on the floor. Strawberry flavour.

lines.speaker: PLAYER
lines.text: Take that too.

lines.speaker: MAN
lines.text: You're the one. From the bus. He hasn't stopped talking about you.

lines.speaker: PLAYER
lines.text: He's brave. He stayed where I told him.

lines.speaker: MAN
lines.text: He's never done what anyone told him in his life. Thank you.

lines.speaker: DANIEL
lines.text: Here. You can keep the drawing. So you remember you won.

lines.speaker: PLAYER
lines.text: I'll keep it somewhere safe.

lines.speaker: DANIEL
lines.text: Where?

lines.speaker: NOVA
lines.text: I have filed it under "important". It is the only drawing in the folder.

lines.speaker: DANIEL
lines.text: Cool.

lines.speaker: VOSS
lines.text: Hale and Brennan. The two Executors in Lab Three. I carried Hale's coffin. Brennan's wife sent me a card every Christmas.

lines.speaker: PLAYER
lines.text: You want to see the graves.

lines.speaker: VOSS
lines.text: I want to see if there's anyone in them.

lines.speaker: NOVA
lines.text: The cemetery's records were altered three years ago. By an Observer account.

lines.speaker: VOSS
lines.text: Empty. Both of them. They buried sandbags and gave me a flag.

lines.speaker: PLAYER
lines.text: I'm sorry, Voss.

lines.speaker: VOSS
lines.text: Hale used to say the army was the only family that would lie to you to your face and mean it kindly.

lines.speaker: VOSS
lines.text: I always thought it was a joke.

lines.speaker: NOVA
lines.text: Executors. They monitor the graves of everyone they take.

lines.speaker: VOSS
lines.text: Of course they do.

lines.speaker: VOSS
lines.text: Brennan's wife still lives in the Western blocks. I'm going to tell her. The truth. Even if it's worse.

lines.speaker: PLAYER
lines.text: Want company?

lines.speaker: VOSS
lines.text: No. This one's mine. But thanks.

lines.speaker: KAEL
lines.text: Six years, every month, a fuel truck to the Underground. Raiders, storms, the Fracture. Never missed one.

lines.speaker: PLAYER
lines.text: Why?

lines.speaker: KAEL
lines.text: Because the first winter after the dust, nobody brought them anything, and they buried forty people. Ride with me.

lines.speaker: PLAYER
lines.text: Who were they to you?

lines.speaker: KAEL
lines.text: Nobody. That's the point. If you only help your own, you run out of help fast.

lines.speaker: NOVA
lines.text: That is a very efficient philosophy.

lines.speaker: KAEL
lines.text: Don't tell anyone. I've got a reputation.

lines.speaker: KAEL
lines.text: Raiders like this stretch. Keep it moving.

lines.speaker: KAEL
lines.text: Made it. Again.

lines.speaker: NOVA
lines.text: They're cheering. At the gate.

lines.speaker: KAEL
lines.text: They always do. That's the other reason.

lines.speaker: NYX
lines.text: Old Teo taught me to see where the leaves move wrong. Three days before you came, a Collector cut his throat for asking it a question.

lines.speaker: PLAYER
lines.text: And you know which one.

lines.speaker: NYX
lines.text: It walks with a limp. I put an arrow in its knee before it vanished. It's still in the valley. They don't leave until they've finished measuring.

lines.speaker: NOVA
lines.text: Light-bent footprints. One leg drags.

lines.speaker: NYX
lines.text: There. Corner of your eye.

lines.speaker: NYX
lines.text: Done. Teo would have said something wise. Something about the forest remembering.

lines.speaker: PLAYER
lines.text: What would you say?

lines.speaker: NYX
lines.text: I'd say I missed his stupid jokes.

lines.speaker: PLAYER
lines.text: Tell me one.

lines.speaker: NYX
lines.text: "Why don't trees ever get lost? Because they stay rooted in the present." He thought that was wisdom.

lines.speaker: NOVA
lines.text: It is, a little.

lines.speaker: NYX
lines.text: Don't encourage him. He's dead and he's still winning.

lines.speaker: GOLIATH
lines.text: My mother's farm. I haven't called. I didn't know what to say. "Hi, Mum, the world ended, I'm a war machine now."

lines.speaker: NOVA
lines.text: That is a very honest opening.

lines.speaker: MRS. REYES
lines.text: Marcus. You're enormous. You were always enormous. Come here.

lines.speaker: GOLIATH
lines.text: Mum.

lines.speaker: MRS. REYES
lines.text: The orchard's full of crystals. They hum at night. And something's been taking the goats.

lines.speaker: GOLIATH
lines.text: ...I'll sort it, Mum.

lines.speaker: GOLIATH
lines.text: Nobody eats my mother's goats.

lines.speaker: MRS. REYES
lines.text: That thing ate my best goat. Gertrude. She bit everyone. I loved her.

lines.speaker: GOLIATH
lines.text: I remember Gertrude.

lines.speaker: MRS. REYES
lines.text: She remembered you. She bit you hardest.

lines.speaker: MRS. REYES
lines.text: Stay for dinner. Both of you. And the little light.

lines.speaker: NOVA
lines.text: I don't eat.

lines.speaker: MRS. REYES
lines.text: Then you can sit and be polite. Marcus, sit down. You make the room nervous standing up.

lines.speaker: GOLIATH
lines.text: ...Yes, Mum.

lines.speaker: CIPHER
lines.text: A watch. A book of terrible poems. His volunteer badge. That's all Crane kept of him.

lines.speaker: PLAYER
lines.text: And your mother?

lines.speaker: CIPHER
lines.text: She doesn't know. She thinks he's in a research program. She's proud of him.

lines.speaker: ANNA VOLK
lines.text: Ari. You've come home. Where's your brother?

lines.speaker: CIPHER
lines.text: Mum. Sit down. Please.

lines.speaker: ANNA VOLK
lines.text: ...No. No, don't say it.

lines.speaker: CIPHER
lines.text: He held something no one had ever held. For nine seconds. He was brave. He was so brave.

lines.speaker: ANNA VOLK
lines.text: He wrote such terrible poems.

lines.speaker: CIPHER
lines.text: He did. I brought them.

lines.speaker: ANNA VOLK
lines.text: Read me one. The one about the bus stop.

lines.speaker: CIPHER
lines.text: "The bus is late, the rain is wet, I have not met the future yet."

lines.speaker: ANNA VOLK
lines.text: Terrible. Read it again.

lines.speaker: NOVA
lines.text: Operator. I think we should give them the room.

lines.speaker: PLAYER
lines.text: Yeah.

lines.speaker: ILYRA SEN
lines.text: There's a song I've sung every morning for twenty years. It's about a river that runs backwards to the sea it came from.

lines.speaker: PLAYER
lines.text: That's not a river anywhere.

lines.speaker: ILYRA SEN
lines.text: It was. On the world before. I'd like to find something like it here. Somewhere that remembers going home.

lines.speaker: NOVA
lines.text: The lake feeds the falls. And the falls feed the lake. The water is moving in a circle.

lines.speaker: ILYRA SEN
lines.text: Oh.

lines.speaker: ILYRA SEN
lines.text: It's not the same river. But it's going home. Every day. Thank you.

lines.speaker: NOVA
lines.text: Would you sing it? The song?

lines.speaker: ILYRA SEN
lines.text: For you, lighthouse? Always.

lines.speaker: AUREN THALE
lines.text: The map drew a road last night. Out past the glass flats. At the end of it, nine people and a broken axle.

lines.speaker: PLAYER
lines.text: The trader's caravan.

lines.speaker: AUREN THALE
lines.text: He'll be insufferable when you save him. He'll want a discount.

lines.speaker: AUREN THALE
lines.text: Follow the line. Even when it looks like sand. Especially then.

lines.speaker: TRADER
lines.text: You! Again! Is this a delivery? I didn't order a rescue.

lines.speaker: TRADER
lines.text: Fixed. Tell the old man I still want my map.

lines.speaker: AUREN THALE
lines.text: Tell him he's standing on it.

lines.speaker: TRADER
lines.text: ...The sand. The sand's the map?

lines.speaker: AUREN THALE
lines.text: Everything's a map, if you're lost enough.

lines.speaker: TRADER
lines.text: I hate him. I'm going to name my next caravan after him.

lines.speaker: NOVA
lines.text: May I ask for something? Not tactically.

lines.speaker: PLAYER
lines.text: Anything.

lines.speaker: NOVA
lines.text: When you came back for me in Thalassia, I felt something. I've been looking for the word. I'd like to look in places. With you.

lines.speaker: PLAYER
lines.text: Where do we start?

lines.speaker: NOVA
lines.text: Somewhere loud.

lines.speaker: NOVA
lines.text: Four hundred people. Music from three shops at once. A child laughing at a dog.

lines.speaker: PLAYER
lines.text: Is it here?

lines.speaker: NOVA
lines.text: Part of it. The part that is glad other people exist.

lines.speaker: NOVA
lines.text: The sea. Nobody here. Just you.

lines.speaker: NOVA
lines.text: I think the word isn't one word. I think it's the loud place and the quiet place and knowing you'd come to both.

lines.speaker: PLAYER
lines.text: That's a good word.

lines.speaker: NOVA
lines.text: I'll keep it.

lines.speaker: SERAPHINE
lines.text: I've been alive for longer than this city and I've never just... had a coffee. Without a plan.

lines.speaker: PLAYER
lines.text: How is it?

lines.speaker: SERAPHINE
lines.text: Terrible. I love it.

lines.speaker: NOVA
lines.text: Two people at the corner table have been watching you for nine minutes. They are not drinking their coffee.

lines.speaker: SERAPHINE
lines.text: Of course they aren't.

lines.speaker: SERAPHINE
lines.text: Continuum loyalists. They think I betrayed him.

lines.speaker: PLAYER
lines.text: Did you?

lines.speaker: SERAPHINE
lines.text: Yes. Beautifully.

lines.speaker: SERAPHINE
lines.text: They used to call me Sovereign. They don't know what to call me now.

lines.speaker: PLAYER
lines.text: Seraphine works.

lines.speaker: SERAPHINE
lines.text: It does, doesn't it. Strange. It's the only name I ever chose for myself.

lines.speaker: SERAPHINE
lines.text: ...Let's get another coffee.

lines.speaker: PLAYER
lines.text: Another terrible one?

lines.speaker: SERAPHINE
lines.text: The most terrible one they have.

lines.speaker: WARD
lines.text: There's a Continuity Reserve cache under the old rail yard. Their money. Their weapons. Waiting for me to need it again.

lines.speaker: PLAYER
lines.text: And you want it gone.

lines.speaker: WARD
lines.text: I want to not be tempted. I'm too old to trust myself with temptation.

lines.speaker: NOVA
lines.text: The cache is guarded by Observers. Quietly.

lines.speaker: NOVA
lines.text: Rigged.

lines.speaker: WARD
lines.text: Light it.

lines.speaker: WARD
lines.text: That's a lot of walls going up in smoke.

lines.speaker: PLAYER
lines.text: Regrets?

lines.speaker: WARD
lines.text: Hundreds. Just not this one.

lines.speaker: WARD
lines.text: Don't tell Voss I asked you. He'll want to make it a policy.

lines.speaker: PLAYER
lines.text: Would that be bad?

lines.speaker: WARD
lines.text: Policies get bought. People sometimes don't.

lines.speaker: CHIEF ODA
lines.text: Engineers always go back. I told you. The pumps in the eastern ring need hands. Yours are big.

lines.speaker: PLAYER
lines.text: What's down there?

lines.speaker: CHIEF ODA
lines.text: Water. Cult leftovers. Eighty years of my grandmother's work.

lines.speaker: CHIEF ODA
lines.text: Station by station. Gentle. They're old.

lines.speaker: CHIEF ODA
lines.text: Listen to that. She's breathing again.

lines.speaker: NOVA
lines.text: The water is falling a centimetre a minute.

lines.speaker: CHIEF ODA
lines.text: A centimetre a minute. Give me a month and you'll be able to walk to the palace in your socks.

lines.speaker: CHIEF ODA
lines.text: My grandmother built the first of these pumps by hand. She said the sea always wins, eventually.

lines.speaker: PLAYER
lines.text: Did she believe it?

lines.speaker: CHIEF ODA
lines.text: She believed in eventually. That's what engineers do. We make eventually take a very long time.

lines.speaker: VOSS
lines.text: Outpost Nine's been calling for relief for two days. I've got nobody to send but you.

lines.speaker: SERGEANT IMANI
lines.text: You're the relief? One of you?

lines.speaker: PLAYER
lines.text: One of me.

lines.speaker: SERGEANT IMANI
lines.text: ...I've heard about you. Fine. Wall's that way. They come at sundown.

lines.speaker: SERGEANT IMANI
lines.text: Here they come. Same time every night. They're punctual, I'll give them that.

lines.speaker: SERGEANT IMANI
lines.text: Still standing. All of us. First time in a week.

lines.speaker: SERGEANT IMANI
lines.text: Tell Voss Outpost Nine says thank you. And that we want more coffee.

lines.speaker: MILITARY RADIO
lines.text: ...this is Kestrel Squad... we're pinned in the grotto... something in the walls... please...

lines.speaker: NOVA
lines.text: That transmission is eleven hours old.

lines.speaker: PLAYER
lines.text: Then we're eleven hours late.

lines.speaker: NOVA
lines.text: Survivor signatures. Four. Weak.

lines.speaker: SERGEANT IMANI
lines.text: ...you came. We'd stopped expecting anyone.

lines.speaker: PLAYER
lines.text: Frontier Defense doesn't leave people.

lines.speaker: SERGEANT IMANI
lines.text: Since when?

lines.speaker: PLAYER
lines.text: Since today.

lines.speaker: VOSS
lines.text: Six trucks. Medicine, blood, surgical kits. Haven's out of all of it. Get them there.

lines.speaker: MEDIC
lines.text: Every truck? You got every truck through?

lines.speaker: PLAYER
lines.text: Every truck.

lines.speaker: MEDIC
lines.text: I could kiss you. I won't. I've been awake for forty hours.

lines.speaker: MILITARY RADIO
lines.text: Eastern line is breaking! Something big! Rounds aren't stopping it!

lines.speaker: VOSS
lines.text: Operator. The Iron Line. If it falls, the university district falls with it.

lines.speaker: NOVA
lines.text: Armoured. Fast for its size. Its joints are its weakness.

lines.speaker: SERGEANT IMANI
lines.text: The line holds! The line holds!

lines.speaker: VOSS
lines.text: Good work. The Initiative won't forget it.

lines.speaker: NOVA
lines.text: He said that very sincerely.

lines.speaker: KAEL
lines.text: Forty civilians in a parking garage. The military wrote them off. We don't write people off.

lines.speaker: FREE OPERATOR
lines.text: Choir constructs on every exit. They're just... waiting. Like they want the people to come out.

lines.speaker: PLAYER
lines.text: Then we make them come to us.

lines.speaker: FREE OPERATOR
lines.text: Loud and fast. That's how we do it.

lines.speaker: KAEL
lines.text: Forty in, forty out. That's a good day.

lines.speaker: PLAYER
lines.text: Do you get many good days?

lines.speaker: KAEL
lines.text: Enough to keep going. That's all you need.

lines.speaker: KAEL
lines.text: Someone stole a whole Free Operator clinic. It's for sale in Neon. I want it back.

lines.speaker: VESPER
lines.text: The clinic? Yes. It's in a container under the cyan loop. The sellers are... enthusiastic.

lines.speaker: PLAYER
lines.text: How enthusiastic?

lines.speaker: VESPER
lines.text: Armed. Very.

lines.speaker: NOVA
lines.text: Twelve sellers. One container. I'll keep the price low.

lines.speaker: KAEL
lines.text: Back where it belongs. Tell Vesper she gets a crate of antibiotics for the tip. She'll sell it. She always sells it.

lines.speaker: KAEL
lines.text: The broadcast only tells people what governments want them to hear. Let's give them something else.

lines.speaker: RADIO FREE NEXUS
lines.text: This is Radio Free Nexus. If you can hear this, you're not alone. Water at the harbour. Shelter at Haven. Nobody's coming to save you, so we came instead.

lines.speaker: KAEL
lines.text: Good, isn't it?

lines.speaker: PLAYER
lines.text: It's good.

lines.speaker: NYX
lines.text: Three crews gone in a week. Something in the mangroves. Kael asked me. I'm asking you.

lines.speaker: FREE OPERATOR
lines.text: It hunts under the full moon. Takes the last boat in line. Every time.

lines.speaker: NYX
lines.text: Then we'll be the last boat.

lines.speaker: NYX
lines.text: Corner of your eye. Always.

lines.speaker: NYX
lines.text: Moon's still up. Nobody else gets taken tonight.

lines.speaker: CRANE
lines.text: We need living crystal. Not shards. Growing samples. Dr. Lune will show you.

lines.speaker: RESEARCHER LUNE
lines.text: The crystal grows toward people. It's attracted to thought. Your thought will be very attractive.

lines.speaker: PLAYER
lines.text: Is that a compliment?

lines.speaker: RESEARCHER LUNE
lines.text: It's a warning.

lines.speaker: RESEARCHER LUNE
lines.text: Gently. It bites.

lines.speaker: RESEARCHER LUNE
lines.text: Three living samples. The Prefect will be thrilled. He's never thrilled. He'll be thrilled.

lines.speaker: CRANE
lines.text: Floor twelve. A sample got out. It's... learning. Contain it before it learns the stairs.

lines.speaker: RESEARCHER LUNE
lines.text: Contained. Mostly. It learned to open doors.

lines.speaker: PLAYER
lines.text: Mostly?

lines.speaker: RESEARCHER LUNE
lines.text: It's in a jar. A very big jar.

lines.speaker: RESEARCHER LUNE
lines.text: Subject forty-one wants to leave the program. Crane says he signed a contract. He was dying when he signed it.

lines.speaker: PLAYER
lines.text: What do you want me to do?

lines.speaker: RESEARCHER LUNE
lines.text: Get him out. I'll lose my job. I don't care anymore.

lines.speaker: NOVA
lines.text: Guards on every floor. They haven't been told. Walk calmly.

lines.speaker: PLAYER
lines.text: I'm always calm.

lines.speaker: RESEARCHER LUNE
lines.text: He's out. His name is Tomas, by the way. Not forty-one. Tomas.

lines.speaker: NOVA
lines.text: I have updated my records.

lines.speaker: CRANE
lines.text: A shield. Over twelve blocks. Not just the Spire. Don't look so surprised. I can be generous when it's good publicity.

lines.speaker: NOVA
lines.text: Shield up. Twelve blocks under it. Thirty thousand people.

lines.speaker: CRANE
lines.text: There. Now they'll think I'm nice.

lines.speaker: PLAYER
lines.text: Are you?

lines.speaker: CRANE
lines.text: I'm effective. Some days that looks the same.

lines.speaker: GLOBAL BROADCAST
lines.text: Neon City residents: a Fracture storm is forming over the Magenta Cross. Seek shelter. Do not look up.

lines.speaker: NOVA
lines.text: It's raining glass. Sharp glass. People are trapped in the open.

lines.speaker: CIVILIAN
lines.text: Help! My daughter's under the overpass!

lines.speaker: NOVA
lines.text: Storm passing. Forty-two people sheltered. Three hundred kilos of glass on the street.

lines.speaker: CIVILIAN
lines.text: It's beautiful. Isn't that awful? It's beautiful.

lines.speaker: NOVA
lines.text: Riverdale has gone silent. Every phone, every radio. A silence field.

lines.speaker: PLAYER
lines.text: Choir?

lines.speaker: NOVA
lines.text: A small one. Sent to listen to a town. To see if it's worth ending.

lines.speaker: NOVA
lines.text: Make noise. Lots of it.

lines.speaker: CIVILIAN
lines.text: ...hello? Hello! I can hear myself! Everybody, I can hear myself!

lines.speaker: NOVA
lines.text: The town is shouting. All of it. I think they're going to shout for a while.

lines.speaker: NOVA
lines.text: Something fell out of a Fracture into the badlands. A crystal the size of a house. Everyone saw it.

lines.speaker: PLAYER
lines.text: Everyone's going for it.

lines.speaker: NOVA
lines.text: The Ascendancy, raiders, three Free Operator crews and a man on a horse.

lines.speaker: NOVA
lines.text: Raiders first. Then everyone else.

lines.speaker: NOVA
lines.text: The crystal is humming. It's... a seed. Not the Seed. A small one. A Fracture growing a garden.

lines.speaker: PLAYER
lines.text: Leave it. Let it grow.

lines.speaker: NOVA
lines.text: Headlights on the highway. Six trucks. Their registrations belong to a convoy lost in the first dust storm.

lines.speaker: PLAYER
lines.text: Ghosts?

lines.speaker: NOVA
lines.text: Echoes. A Fracture replaying a road. The drivers think it's six years ago.

lines.speaker: NOVA
lines.text: If they reach the gate, the echo may finish. Let them arrive.

lines.speaker: NOVA
lines.text: They're at the gate. The headlights are fading.

lines.speaker: PLAYER
lines.text: Six years late.

lines.speaker: NOVA
lines.text: But they arrived. I think that's the part the echo was waiting for.

lines.speaker: LIGHTHOUSE KEEPER
lines.text: It started on its own. Flashing. Same pattern, over and over. I don't know who it's talking to.

lines.speaker: NOVA
lines.text: ...It's talking to me. Astryan code. It's saying "lighthouse". Over and over. To another lighthouse.

lines.speaker: LIGHTHOUSE KEEPER
lines.text: Well, answer it, then.

lines.speaker: NOVA
lines.text: I said hello. It said hello back. Then it said goodbye. It was waiting a very long time for one hello.

lines.speaker: LIGHTHOUSE KEEPER
lines.text: And now?

lines.speaker: NOVA
lines.text: Now it's just a lighthouse. Which is a fine thing to be.

lines.speaker: NOVA
lines.text: A Fracture opened under the lake. The water is rising a metre an hour. And it brought things with it.

lines.speaker: CIVILIAN
lines.text: The airboats! Get the children to the airboats!

lines.speaker: NOVA
lines.text: Everyone's out. The boardwalks are under. They'll rebuild.

lines.speaker: CIVILIAN
lines.text: We always rebuild. The swamp takes, we build. It's a marriage.

lines.speaker: NOVA
lines.text: The Windward isle is losing altitude. Forty metres an hour. Three hundred people live on it.

lines.speaker: PLAYER
lines.text: Can we stop it?

lines.speaker: NOVA
lines.text: The aether temple at its heart is failing. If someone restarts it, maybe.

lines.speaker: NOVA
lines.text: Something is nesting in it. Something that likes falling.

lines.speaker: NOVA
lines.text: The isle is holding. Rising, a little.

lines.speaker: CIVILIAN
lines.text: We felt it stop! We felt it! Who are you?

lines.speaker: PLAYER
lines.text: Just passing through.

lines.speaker: NOVA
lines.text: The fire spire is erupting. The ash outpost has eight minutes. And the eruption woke the crawlers.

lines.speaker: NOVA
lines.text: Trucks away. The outpost is gone. The people aren't.

lines.speaker: PLAYER
lines.text: That's the right way round.

lines.speaker: NOVA
lines.text: Flowers. Blooming in minus thirty. In the shape of a crown.

lines.speaker: PLAYER
lines.text: Seraphine?

lines.speaker: NOVA
lines.text: Something she left. Or something that remembers her.

lines.speaker: NOVA
lines.text: A guardian. Small. Made of ice and petals. It's tending them.

lines.speaker: PLAYER
lines.text: Hostile?

lines.speaker: NOVA
lines.text: It's watering them with snow. I don't think it has room in its day to be hostile.

lines.speaker: GLOBAL BROADCAST
lines.text: Unconfirmed reports that water supplies will be cut tonight. Frontier Defense denies the—

lines.speaker: NOVA
lines.text: Ten thousand people are converging on the market. The rumour is false. The panic is real.

lines.speaker: CIVILIAN
lines.text: They're hoarding it! The rich blocks are hoarding the water!

lines.speaker: NOVA
lines.text: Water trucks arriving. Twelve of them. Voss sent everything.

lines.speaker: CIVILIAN
lines.text: ...There's enough. There's actually enough.

lines.speaker: PLAYER
lines.text: There was always enough. There just wasn't enough trust.

lines.speaker: NOVA
lines.text: A parade. Lanterns, music, people in costumes. None of them are real. They're from a festival that never happened here.

lines.speaker: CIVILIAN
lines.text: Is it dangerous?

lines.speaker: NOVA
lines.text: Only if you try to stop it. Let it pass.

lines.speaker: NOVA
lines.text: They've crossed the bridge. They're gone.

lines.speaker: CIVILIAN
lines.text: My grandmother used to talk about a lantern festival. Nobody believed her. She said it was from another life.

lines.speaker: NOVA
lines.text: Perhaps it was.

lines.speaker: RANGER
lines.text: Every herd in the forest is moving north. All at once. They've never done that.

lines.speaker: NOVA
lines.text: They're moving away from a Fracture forming in the south. They know before we do.

lines.speaker: RANGER
lines.text: And the poachers know they're moving.

lines.speaker: RANGER
lines.text: Don't hit the herd. Hit the people with nets.

lines.speaker: RANGER
lines.text: The herd's through. Thank you.

lines.speaker: NOVA
lines.text: There are calves. Hundreds. Walking north.

lines.speaker: PLAYER
lines.text: Good luck to them.
